policies.name: Users can inspect own administrator status
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Users can inspect own administrator status" ON public.admin_users FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING ((user_id = auth.uid()))

policies.name: Company owners can manage advisors
policies.using: (company_id IN (SELECT companies.id FROM public.companies WHERE (companies.verified_owner_id = auth.uid())))
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Company owners can manage advisors" ON public.advisors FOR ALL TO authenticated USING ((company_id IN (SELECT companies.id FROM public.companies WHERE (companies.verified_owner_id = auth.uid()))))

policies.name: Public read access for advisors
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Public read access for advisors" ON public.advisors FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated USING ((active = true))

policies.name: Company owners can update their listings
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Company owners can update their listings" ON public.companies FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING ((verified_owner_id = auth.uid()))

policies.name: Public read access for companies
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Public read access for companies" ON public.companies FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated USING (true)

policies.name: Users can create claims
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Users can create claims" ON public.listing_claims FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK ((claimant_user_id = auth.uid()))

policies.name: Users can update their pending claims
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Users can update their pending claims" ON public.listing_claims FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (((claimant_user_id = auth.uid()) AND (claim_status = 'pending'::public.claim_status)))

policies.name: Users can view their own claims
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Users can view their own claims" ON public.listing_claims FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING ((claimant_user_id = auth.uid()))

policies.name: Company owners can manage media
policies.using: (company_id IN (SELECT companies.id FROM public.companies WHERE (companies.verified_owner_id = auth.uid())))
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Company owners can manage media" ON public.media_content FOR ALL TO authenticated USING ((company_id IN (SELECT companies.id FROM public.companies WHERE (companies.verified_owner_id = auth.uid()))))

policies.name: Public read access for approved media
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Public read access for approved media" ON public.media_content FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated USING ((moderation_status = 'approved'::public.moderation_status))

policies.name: Published company reviews are public
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Published company reviews are public" ON public.reviews FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated USING ((moderation_status = 'approved'::public.moderation_status))

policies.name: Users can create own company reviews
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Users can create own company reviews" ON public.reviews FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (((reviewer_user_id = auth.uid()) AND (moderation_status = 'approved'::public.moderation_status)))

policies.name: Users can delete own company reviews
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Users can delete own company reviews" ON public.reviews FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING ((reviewer_user_id = auth.uid()))

policies.name: Users can update own company reviews
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Users can update own company reviews" ON public.reviews FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING ((reviewer_user_id = auth.uid())) WITH CHECK (((reviewer_user_id = auth.uid()) AND (moderation_status = 'approved'::public.moderation_status)))

policies.name: Users can view and update their own profile
policies.definition: CREATE POLICY "Users can view and update their own profile" ON public.users FOR ALL TO authenticated USING ((id = auth.uid()))

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition: CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin() RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER PARALLEL SAFE SET search_path TO '' AS $$ SELECT COALESCE(auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.admin_users AS administrator WHERE administrator.user_id = auth.uid() AND administrator.is_active), false); $$

functions.name: update_updated_at_column
functions.definition: CREATE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at := NOW(); RETURN NEW; END; $$

triggers.name: update_admin_users_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER update_admin_users_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.admin_users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column()
